skills.name: Effects and weaknesses of the Berlin settlement

note.text: The conference strengthened a framework for imperial competition while excluding African political equality. It assisted claims and expansion but did not itself implement every conquest or draw all later borders. Its proclaimed humanitarian and commercial language must be compared with subsequent coercion and exploitation. Boundaries and colonial policies could disrupt existing relations or divide connected communities. Results varied by place. The process should be assessed through its rules, implementation and affected peoples, not through the conference's stated aims alone.

sections.heading: Understand the ideas
sections.text: The conference strengthened a framework for imperial competition while excluding African political equality. It assisted claims and expansion but did not itself implement every conquest or draw all later borders. Its proclaimed humanitarian and commercial language must be compared with subsequent coercion and exploitation. Boundaries and colonial policies could disrupt existing relations or divide connected communities. Results varied by place. The process should be assessed through its rules, implementation and affected peoples, not through the conference's stated aims alone.

sections.heading: Apply the ideas locally
sections.text: A rule intended to reduce conflict among imperial states did not guarantee peace for African communities resisting conquest. A trade provision did not guarantee equal bargaining power. When comparing a conference document with later events, identify what the document promises and what additional evidence is needed to judge the outcome.

sections.heading: Reason and check
sections.text: Separate aims from effects and framework from implementation. Avoid saying every modern border was drawn at Berlin. A criticism is stronger when it identifies a specific exclusion or consequence and links it to evidence rather than repeating a slogan alone.
